item.title: Microservices Architecture
item.description: MSA is a decision about which axis to use to divide the system. Domain, data ownership, scale pattern, failure boundary — the chosen axis creates the boundaries, and those boundaries decide communication and data in turn.

item.title: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2
item.description: HTTP/1.1 processes requests and responses sequentially. HTTP/2 changed this with multiplexing, binary framing, and header compression. A summary of the differences between the two protocols and gRPC, which runs on top of HTTP/2.
